acceptance_predicates.description: Setup writes only to an explicit --output path and never creates hidden user configuration.
Interactive setup can choose every supported agent, provider, model, workload, monitor, measure, and bounded run/sweep setting.
Noninteractive flags can author the same valid configuration as the wizard.
Live configuration records acknowledgement and credential references only; missing development credentials are actionable at execution rather than leaked or silently substituted.

definition_of_done: A user can author a complete portable live or offline benchmark configuration in one setup command.

inputs.description: AR-1826 configuration schema and binding contract.

outputs.description: Complete setup wizard and flag route writing the explicit config file.

gates.description: PTY/noninteractive setup matrix proves complete selection, redaction, and explicit-file behavior.
